name: Vinc
description: Vinc account graph as OpenClaw memory: recall from the memory slot and a corpus supplement, both read only.

apiKey.description: A read-only Vinc key (vinc_ro_) from the vincs.io account page.

agents.description: Agent ids that get the memory_search and memory_get tools. List only agents that serve you alone; empty gives the tools to no agent.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for one hub call, in milliseconds.
